name: Democracy PAC
summary: George Soros's super PAC, launched for the 2020 cycle and now run by his son Alex Soros. With Democracy PAC II it received $102 million from the Soros family in the 2026 cycle and passed money on to other Democratic groups, including $9 million to Senate Majority PAC as well as House Majority PAC and J Street's super PAC.
